name: job-search
description: Run a whole job hunt from Claude Code or from inside Second Brain Studio: sweep the market against your own criteria, tailor a CV per role, fill the application, and keep the results as an indexed layer of your Second Brain.

network.why: Job discovery reads public, unauthenticated job-board APIs. The Second Brain Link engine itself stays zero-network; this plugin is a separate distribution surface and declares its access here.
endpoints: employer career pages reached by WebFetch on a specific posting
